    Before you pay

    Yearly usually means upfront

    "Rp 30 jt a year" normally means 12 months paid at once, plus a deposit. Ask about 6-month or monthly terms.

    Utilities are extra

    Service charge (IPL), prepaid electricity and water add roughly Rp 300–700k a month for a studio.

    See it live

    Several listings tagged "furnished" were empty rooms. Ask for a video call or visit before paying anything.

    Getting to Imigrasi

    From Amethyst, Elpis or Grand Kartini walk 10–15 minutes, or ride one stop from KRL Rajawali to Kemayoran. From The Mansion, Boutique or Puri, walk 15–20 minutes or take a JAK feeder bus.
